conviction_note: Q3 2026 is a first look at new numbers (no szacunkowe wyniki filed; current reports 1-15/2026 hold none), on a no-coverage name with 116% realised vol whose last print moved +26.6% the next session, so abs_move is 9; the sign is near a coin: the closest listed peer (Action) printed a 4x Q3 profit and NTT built inventory into the component-price surge, against a Q2 probably padded by KPO school-laptop deliveries, a likely second negative operating cash flow and a stock that has already doubled since the H1 print. p_up 54 gives +0.72; the findings sum to -0.30. The two disagree in sign because the findings net small positives (proxy, already public) against two specific negatives, while p_up also counts this name's run of four positive next-session reactions to its prints.

findings.finding: The closest listed Polish peer, Action S.A. (an IT distributor that also assembles PCs), pre-released Q3 2026 net profit of 35.8m PLN, about 4x Q3 2025. This suggests the component-price tailwind to distributor margins that drove NTT's Q2 lasted through July-September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NTT has risen the session after each of its last four prints (Q3'25 +4.0% on 1 Dec 2025; FY'25 +2.2% on 27 Mar; Q1'26 +5.4%/+4.3%; H1'26 +26.6% on 1 Oct), each time on reported profit growth
findings.original_quote: W III kwartale Grupa Kapitałowa Action wypracowała 35,8 mln zł zysku netto. To czterokrotny wzrost zysku w porównaniu z III kw. 2025 r. (In Q3 the Action group earned PLN 35.8m net profit, a fourfold increase on Q3 2025.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Action's numbers came out 17 Nov at 09:13, and NTT closed +1.5% and +0.6% on the next two sessions on below-average volume. Had the read-across to NTT been priced, NTT would not have drifted from 35.4 to 32.0 over 19-25 Nov. It is a peer proxy, not NTT's own number, and nobody publishes an NTT estimate to move.
findings.independence: Asbis Q3 2026 (record quarter, net $51.6m vs $11.6m), https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/11/05/asbis-revenue-more-than-doubles-as-ai-demand-drives-record-quarter. That one is mostly AI/server-driven, so it supports the channel only weakly

findings.finding: NTT went into Q3 with inventory of 290.8m PLN (45% of assets), up from 196.2m at 31.12.2025. Management wrote that component price rises pass into finished-goods prices with a lag and that goods built from cheaper components compete with newer, dearer stock, which is the mechanism behind a Q3 margin carried by low-cost inventory.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: the H1 print, which first showed this margin (Q2 EBIT 20.9m vs 5.2m a year earlier), moved the stock +26.6% the next session and began a doubling
findings.original_quote: Podwyżki cen u producentów półprzewodników nie przenoszą się w czasie rzeczywistym na ceny wyrobów gotowych, ale obserwujemy proces wzrostu cen SRP. Obecnie na rynku ścierają się oferty towarów, wyprodukowanych przy wyższych kosztach, z tymi, które były wyprodukowane wcześniej z tańszych podzespołów. [...] Wyniki za I półrocze 2026 r. napawają nadzieją i optymizmem [...] tak aby zakończyć rok obrotowy zgodnie z założeniami, a nawet wygenerować nadwyżkę nad plan. (Semiconductor price increases do not pass into finished-goods prices in real time, but we observe SRP rising. Goods made at higher cost now compete with goods made earlier from cheaper components. [...] The H1 results give hope and optimism [...] to finish the year in line with assumptions, or even generate a surplus over plan.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: this document is public since 30 Sept and the stock has doubled on it. What remains is that nobody has turned it into a Q3 number, since there is no coverage, so the quarter is still a surprise in either direction. The finding is sized near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: the same H1 document underlies the cash-flow finding below (shared fact: the inventory build); the DRAM contract-price trend through mid-2026 (https://antyweb.pl/spadek-cen-dram-nand-ram, TrendForce Q2 DRAM +58-63% q/q, still rising) supports the mechanism

findings.finding: Q2 2026's 349m PLN revenue probably included NTT Technology's share of the KPO school-laptop contract (consortium led by Intaris: 53,942 laptops, 154.3m PLN gross, 11 of 64 subregions). The programme aimed for every school to reach its device ratio by 31 Aug 2026, so Q3 likely lost that volume and revenue may fall sequentially.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no prior print isolated a public-tender revenue line; H1's 'own products +100%' line came with a +26.6% reaction
findings.original_quote: Łączna wartość brutto dostaw realizowanych przez konsorcjum wyniesie 154 317 278.46 zł, obejmując 53 942 sztuki laptopów. [...] termin realizacji zamówień wykonawczych wyniesie nie dłużej niż 40 dni od daty zawarcia umowy. (Total gross value of deliveries by the consortium will be PLN 154.3m, covering 53,942 laptops. [...] Each call-off order is to be fulfilled within 40 days of contract signature.)
findings.why_not_priced: The timing is an inference. Neither the company nor the ministry has said when the consortium delivered, and NTT's share of the 154m is undisclosed. The H1 report only says 'bardzo cieszy nas ponad 100% wzrost sprzedaż produktów własnej produkcji' (own-production sales more than doubled) without naming KPO. A market extrapolating the Q2 run-rate after a 2x re-rating would show exactly this blind spot. Sized small because it is an inference and the bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: the 31 Aug 2026 school device-ratio deadline (portal summarised at https://www.portaloswiatowy.pl/wazne-wydarzenia-dla-szkol-i-przedszkoli/laptopy-dla-szkol-2025-rozstrzygniecie-przetargu-i-harmonogram-dostaw-27069.html; snippet only, not opened)

findings.finding: The inventory build turned H1 operating cash flow to -14.2m PLN (+29.1m a year earlier) and was funded by a run of new and enlarged factoring and credit lines (PKO Faktoring limit to 70m, Pekao reverse factoring 40m, three Millennium agreements on 31 July, Pekao credit annexes). Q3's cash flow line will show whether the working-capital build continued.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: the H1 print carried the -14.2m operating cash flow and still moved +26.6%; on this name profit has dominated cash so far
findings.original_quote: Przepływy pieniężne netto z działalności operacyjnej -14 242 [H1 2026] 29 145 [H1 2025] (Net operating cash flow -14,242k PLN vs 29,145k PLN)
findings.why_not_priced: The financing buys inventory that has been gaining in value, since revenue is +23% and Q2 EBIT quadrupled, so it is a ramp and not distress, and the sign stays small. The risk is that a second negative quarter of operating cash flow, after the re-rating, puts the earnings quality in question. Nobody models NTT's working capital, so there is no figure in the price to compare with.
findings.independence: facility reports RB 2, 3, 10-14/2026 on https://ntt.pl/raporty-biezace-2026/ (same company, different documents); shares the inventory-build fact with the finding above
